```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("R/gallery.R")
```

```{r}
#| label: contact-page
# Contact details as a named list — edit these to personalise the page
contact_info <- list(
  text    = "(+1) 331.777.0897",
  location = "CHICAGO | ILLINOIS | MICHIGAN",
  services = c("Editorial", "Commercial", "Fine Art Prints")
)

social_links <- data.frame(
  platform = c("Instagram", "Facebook", "500px"),
  icon     = c("bi-instagram", "bi-facebook", "bi-camera"),
  href     = c("https://instagram.com", "https://facebook.com", "https://500px.com"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ── Build contact detail rows ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
detail_rows <- list(
  tags$div(
    class = "contact-line",
    "Email \u00a0\u2014\u00a0",
    tags$a(href = paste0("mailto:", contact_info$email), contact_info$email)
  ),
  tags$div(
    class = "contact-line",
    "Based in \u00a0\u2014\u00a0",
    contact_info$location
  ),
  tags$div(
    class = "contact-line",
    "Available for \u00a0\u2014\u00a0",
    paste(contact_info$services, collapse = " \u00b7 ")
  )
)

# ── Build social icon links ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
social_icons <- mapply(
  FUN       = function(platform, icon, href) {
    tags$a(
      href         = href,
      `aria-label` = platform,
      tags$i(class = paste("bi", icon))
    )
  },
  platform  = social_links$platform,
  icon      = social_links$icon,
  href      = social_links$href,
  SIMPLIFY  = FALSE,
  USE.NAMES = FALSE
)

# ── Assemble page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tags$div(
  class = "contact-container",

  section_heading("Contact"),

  tags$p(
    style = "margin-top:2.5rem;",
    "Whether you are interested in commissioning a project, licensing an",
    "image, or simply want to say hello \u2014 I would love to hear from you."
  ),

  do.call(tags$div, c(list(class = "contact-details"), detail_rows)),

  tags$hr(style = "border-color:#222; margin:2.5rem 0;"),

  tags$p(
    style = "font-size:0.85rem; color:#666; letter-spacing:0.05em;",
    "I aim to respond within two business days.",
    "For time-sensitive enquiries, please mention that in the subject line."
  ),

  do.call(tags$div, c(list(class = "contact-social"), social_icons)),

  tags$div(
    style = "margin-top:3rem;",
    tags$a(href = "portfolio.html", class = "btn-photo btn-photo-muted", "View Portfolio")
  )
)
```
